groups.root_cause: Moving the cut point across dense overlapping credential matches removes the bound on the streaming carry buffer, so it can grow without limit.
Restoring run state applies credential redaction to the executable gate configuration, and checkpoints then save the altered command.
Gate output is redacted before the sandbox startup marker is detected, so a credential that occurs inside the marker breaks startup detection.
Gate-specific output normalization (adding a confinement verdict and stripping escapes) is applied to every object and HTTP response, not only to gate results.
The output privacy filter treats any text containing the "[redacted]" marker as sensitive and withholds the whole field.
stdout and stderr are redacted separately and then joined, so a credential split across the two streams is rebuilt in the stored tail.
The deployment path in the CLI service runs gates without first registering configured credentials in the redaction registry.
New stdoutTruncated/stderrTruncated result fields were added that no production code reads.
